title: ProjectDeliveryProfile
description: Versioned, per-project delivery configuration (punokawan-14yn.4): local path, canonical remote, branch policy, build/test commands, required services, and CI/worker policy. Explicit repository configuration takes precedence over global detected or learned defaults; this record only stores the merged, effective values a preflight run and approval manifest are computed against. See affiliate-platform-delivery-feedback-2026-08-07.md.

local_path.description: Absolute path to an existing local checkout, if one is already known; absent when only the remote is known and a worktree has not been created yet.

canonical_remote.description: Remote name (e.g. "origin") preflight and worktree creation fetch from.

required_services.description: Names of external services (referenced by capability status only, per this task's boundary - never a credential value).

revision.description: Optimistic-concurrency counter; incremented on every update.
